notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Sections 7 to 10 of Pub. L. 109–449, formerly classified to sections 1956 to 1959, respectively, of this title, were renumbered sections 131 to 134 of Pub. L. 109–449 by Pub. L. 119–65, § 4(b)(1), Dec. 26, 2025, 139 Stat. 1989, and transferred to sections 1981 to 1984, respectively, of this title.
